gap_and_change.observed_gap: A saved video/audio Media Library ID restored into an Inspector had only a static selected label, so the Editor could not tell whether the selected object had been deleted, archived, or was inaccessible. The metadata probe also needed to exclude archived rows, matching active Media Library and GET semantics.
gap_and_change.api: Authenticated HEAD /api/admin/media?id=<uuid> performs a site-scoped D1 lookup for an active (archived_at IS NULL), supported media row and R2 head metadata lookup only. It returns no body, never calls R2 get, uses private no-store and Vary: Cookie, and gives 404 for absent, archived, or missing objects and 503 for R2 metadata failures.
gap_and_change.ui: Restored playable selections now probe HEAD with same-origin credentials and announce unavailable/network-unknown state. A selection revision guard ignores stale responses; replacing or clearing the selection clears the former warning. Recovery remains an explicit remove/reselect action and does not invoke Save or Publish by itself.
